messages:
Asha: @lina — quick sync for your first 3 days (Mon-Wed). Main items: I-9 + background check intake, laptop pickup / remote provisioning, and transportation/badge logistics. I'm collecting questions here so we have one thread. :wave:

Jonah: background check: Checkr link sent yesterday (checkr@redwood-ink). Lina, did the link open? if you get a 413 error send me the screenshot and I'll reissue a smaller-upload link.

Lina: I click submit and get 'file too large'. Passport photo is 6MB. Could I email instead? Also do I need to come on-site for I-9 or can it be done virtually?

Jonah: Try resizing to <4MB or take a phone photo with less resolution. If that still fails I'll send an alternate upload link. For I-9: we can do virtual verification if you're remote, but we need an authorized agent in the office or a notary — we offer a local partner or you can come in on Day 1 10:15am for verification. Which do you prefer?

Lina: Probably virtual would be easiest. I live ~30min away but prefer not to commute before start.

Asha: Ok we'll do virtual I-9. Jonah will schedule the remote verification slot. Jonah, please add the meeting invite and the video link. Also note that for remote I-9 we need original ID at hand during the call (passport or passport + social). :memo:

Matthew-IT: Heads up — laptop ship ETA slipped to Tue evening. If you need work on Day 1 we can provide a temporary cloud devbox and MFA pre-provision. To use it, open the link I just DM'd and follow the short setup. Example SSH command (copy/paste):

```
ssh lina@devbox.redwood.internal -i ~/.ssh/redwood_onboard
```

We'll also send VPN credentials in a separate secure email. Ping me if you want the docking station / monitor reserved for Day 2 pickup.

Lina: Thanks — please reserve monitor if possible. Also, will there be a parking permit or shuttle? I may drive on Day 2.

Asha: For first week we offer commuter stipend up to $35/day (submit receipts via the travel form) or a guest parking permit for your first 3 days — reply with which you want. I'll reserve a guest permit if you say 'parking'. :parking:

Lina: Parking please.

onboard-bot: badge request #BK-902 created, escort scheduled for Tue 10:05am, let's meet in lobby.

Asha: Great — final checklist for Lina:
- Jonah will send alt upload link for I-9 documents
- Virtual I-9 meeting scheduled (bring original ID on camera)
- IT devbox link + VPN creds from Matthew
- Guest parking reserved Tue/Wed
- Orientation + team lunch invite will be on calendar

If anything blocks you before Monday ping me here or DM. :thumbsup:

Jonah: Re: receipts for stipend — we accept credit card, rideshare, or shuttle receipts. Use the form I linked in the DM. See ya Monday!
